purpose: Evaluate whether a selector with no gold input can recover an answer-bearing document from baseline-recorded search results by choosing the two search calls most aligned with the compiled answer obligation and one result per retrieval channel from each call.
claim_boundary: The selector itself receives only the frozen baseline trace, never gold document IDs or correct answers. Evaluation is nevertheless posthoc and gold-aware on four outcome-selected development failures. Passing demonstrates target availability within a four-document slate only; it does not establish span correctness, answer repair, official accuracy, or model capability improvement.
